Package library.ui

package library.ui
Swing user interface: LoginFrame / SignUpPanel, MainFrame, the role panels AdminPanel and StudentPanel with their pages, and reusable components such as UIStyle, StatCard, TableCard, SidebarPanel and SearchFilterBar. The UI contains no business rules; it calls the services and shows their errors.
Author:
Usman
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    library
    Java-Based Library Book Management System (Open-Ended Lab).
    library.exception
    Custom exceptions.
    library.model
    Model classes of the library: Book, Member, User, Loan, Transaction and the enums BookStatus, Category, Role and TransactionType.
    library.service
    Business logic and validation: LibraryService (books, loans, reservations, search, overdue, statistics), MemberService, AuthService (sign up / sign in / roles / hashing), TransactionService (history) and LibrarySystem, which wires them to the data store.
    library.storage
    Persistence: DataStore saves and loads users, books, members, loans and transactions as CSV files in the data/ folder using only java.nio.

    Description
    AdminPanel
    Admin / Librarian panel: a sidebar (Dashboard, Books, Issue/Return, Members, Overdue, Transactions, Logout) and a CardLayout content area showing the selected page.
    BooksPanel
    Admin book management: add, view, update, delete and change status of books, with a live search and filter bar above the table.
    BrowseBooksPanel
    Student "Browse Books" page: read-only catalogue with the same search and filter bar as the admin view.
    DashboardPanel
    Admin dashboard: coloured statistic cards (Total, Available, Issued and Reserved books, Total Members, Overdue count) and a table of the most recent activity.

    Window background for the liquid glass theme: a near-black base lit by soft, large blue and cyan glows, with a darker vignette at the bottom.

    Issue and return screen.
    LoginFrame
    The start window: a split layout with a branding panel on the left and a form card on the right that switches between Sign In and SignUpPanel.
    LoginFrame.BrandingPanel
    Left-hand branding area: floating liquid-glass orbs, a large title with a blue-to-cyan gradient, a tagline and the feature list.
    LoginFrame.GradientLabel
    Label whose text is painted with a blue-to-cyan gradient.

    Main application window shown after login.
    MembersPanel
    Member management: register members (auto-generated MEM-xxx IDs), view them in a table, search by name or ID, update and delete (members with active loans cannot be deleted).

    Student "My Books" page: the student's currently issued and reserved books with issue date, due date and an overdue warning (rows highlighted in red) when a book is late.

    NavigationPanel
    Base class for role panels: a SidebarPanel on the left and a CardLayout content area on the right.
    OverduePanel
    Overdue tracking: lists every loan that has not been returned and whose due date is before today, with the number of days overdue.
    Refreshable
    Implemented by panels that can reload their data from the services after a change.

    Reusable search and filter bar for book tables: a search text field, a search-by combo (Book ID / Title / Author), a status filter, a category filter and a Reset button.

    SidebarPanel.NavButton

    SignUpPanel

    StudentPanel

    TableCard
